description: This Java source file defines the NotStrictlyPositiveException class, which extends NumberIsTooSmallException, used to signal when a number argument is not strictly positive (less than or equal to zero). It includes constructors for general use and with specific context.

classes.name: NotStrictlyPositiveException
classes.description: Exception to be thrown when a numerical argument is not strictly positive, i.e., less than or equal to zero. Extends NumberIsTooSmallException and provides constructors for creating instances with or without specific context.
